passive.name: Deep, Deep Breaths
passive.text: Increases the wearer's Energy Regeneration Rate by **12/14/16/18/20%**. When any ally uses their Ultimate, the wearer restores HP for the ally currently with the lowest HP percentage by an amount equal to **10/11/12/13/14%** of the healed ally's Max HP. When the wearer provides healing for an ally, increases the healed ally's ATK by **2.4/2.8/3.2/3.6/4%**. This effect can stack up to **5** times and lasts for **2** turn(s).

passive.name: Morn, Noon, Dusk, and Night
passive.text: Increases the wearer's Max HP by **18/21/24/27/30%** and Outgoing Healing by **12/14/16/18/20%**. When the wearer heals allies, record the amount of Outgoing Healing. When any ally launches an attack, a random attacked enemy takes Additional DMG equal to **36/42/48/54/60%** of the recorded Outgoing Healing value. The type of this Additional DMG is of the same Type as the wearer's. This Additional DMG is not affected by other buffs, and can only occur 1 time per turn.

passive.name: Mutual Healing
passive.text: Increases the wearer's Energy Regeneration Rate by **8/10/12/14/16%** and increases Outgoing Healing when they use their Ultimate by **12/15/18/21/24%**.

passive.name: Farewell
passive.text: Increases the wearer's Outgoing Healing by **12/15/18/21/24%**. When an ally target's current HP percentage is greater than or equal to **50%**, increases the DMG dealt by **12/14/16/18/20%**.

passive.name: Refraction of Sightline
passive.text: Increases the wearer's Effect RES by **16/20/24/28/32%** and increases Outgoing Healing by an amount that is equal to **33/36/39/42/45%** of Effect RES. Outgoing Healing can be increased this way by up to **15/18/21/24/27%**.

passive.name: Enjoy With Rapture
passive.text: At the start of the wearer's turn, regenerates **8/10/12/14/16** Energy for a randomly chosen ally (excluding the wearer) whose current Energy is lower than **50%**.

passive.name: Denizens of Abundance
passive.text: After the wearer uses their Basic ATK, their next action will be Advanced Forward by **12/14/16/18/20%**.

tracePriority: Vidyadhara Ichor Lines (A4) > Aquatic Benediction (A6) > Qihuang Analects (A2)

entries.name: Diagnostic Kick
entries.text: Deals Lightning DMG equal to **100%** of Bailu's ATK to one designated enemy.

entries.name: Singing Among Clouds
entries.text: Heals a single ally for **11.7%** of Bailu's Max HP plus **312**. Bailu then heals random allies **2** time(s). After each healing, HP restored from the next healing is reduced by **15%**.

entries.name: Felicitous Thunderleap
entries.text:
Heals all allies for **13.5%** of Bailu's Max HP plus **360**.
Bailu applies Invigoration to allies that are not already Invigorated. For those already Invigorated, Bailu extends the duration of their Invigoration by 1 turn.
The effect of Invigoration can last for **2** turn(s). This effect cannot stack.

entries.name: Gourdful of Elixir
entries.text:
After an ally target with Invigoration is hit, restores the ally's HP for **5.4%** of Bailu's Max HP plus **144**. This effect can trigger **2** time(s).
When Bailu's teammate receives a killing blow, they will not be knocked down. Bailu immediately heals the ally for **18%** of Bailu's Max HP plus **480** HP. This effect can be triggered 1 time per battle.

entries.name: Saunter in the Rain
entries.text: After Technique is used, at the start of the next battle, all allies are granted Invigoration for **2** turn(s).

entries.name: Qihuang Analects
entries.text: When Bailu heals a target ally above their normal Max HP, the target's Max HP increases by **10%** for **2** turns.

entries.name: Aquatic Benediction
entries.text: Characters with Invigoration receive **10%** less DMG.

entries.name: Ambrosial Aqua
entries.text: If the target ally's current HP is equal to their Max HP when Invigoration ends, regenerates 8 extra Energy for this target.

entries.name: Sylphic Slumber
entries.text: After using her Ultimate, Bailu's Outgoing Healing increases by an additional 15% for 2 turn(s).

entries.name: Omniscient Opulence
entries.text:
Skill Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.
Talent Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.

entries.name: Evil Excision
entries.text: Every healing provided by the Skill makes the recipient deal 10% more DMG for 2 turn(s). This effect can stack up to 3 time(s).

entries.name: Waning Worries
entries.text:
Ultimate Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.
Basic ATK Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. 10.

entries.name: Drooling Drop of Draconic Divinity
entries.text: Bailu can heal allies who received a killing blow 1 more time(s) in a single battle.
